statement: A guest says a delivery driver left a crate beside the front door.
A catering assistant heard a guest addressed as Professor Dingler. He carried an envelope into the study and left it in the desk drawer.
A server remembers someone arguing about a missing coat in the hallway.
A musician saw someone leave the study carrying several loose sheets.
A neighbor says a person in a pale jacket crossed the lawn.
A guest recalls a telephone ringing in the dining room.
